decisions.reason: A complete same-message MODIFY already records the required Option B terminal, subtle reach increase, and softened-terminal constraints for the É accent.
A complete same-message MODIFY already records Option B as the preferred terminal basis, the subtle right-arm reach increase, geometry preservation, and the straight-tip softness constraint.
A complete same-message MODIFY already limits the next presentation to the specified reach and terminal nuances while preserving all other locked architecture.
The client expressly keeps everything else unchanged; the E and L construction, proportions, and architectural vocabulary are not modified.
The source changes the second V's reach and terminal nuances but locks its broad architecture; it does not change the established height hierarchy relative to the E, L, Hero V, or É accent.

Applying the reach refinement consistently does not alter the existing requirement that the Hero V and É accent share the same peak horizon; the requested reference line concerns right-arm rise above the left arm.
